bank.description: Bank id, must match an id in banks.json

name.description: Official card name in Traditional Chinese, e.g. CUBE卡

levels.description: Card tiers offered under this product, e.g. ["御璽卡", "鈦金卡", "世界卡"]

amount.description: Standard annual fee in TWD for the lowest tier (0 if none)

max_amount.description: Annual fee of the highest tier if multiple

waiver.description: Waiver conditions in plain text, e.g. 首年免年費，次年消費滿 X 次免年費

effectively_free.description: true when the typical cardholder pays nothing (free, or waiver is trivially met)

reward_type.description: Primary reward category used for site classification

headline.description: One-line hook for list cards, e.g. 指定通路最高 3.3% 回饋

label.description: Where/what the rate applies to, e.g. 一般消費 / 指定網購 / 海外消費

rate.description: Human-readable rate, e.g. 1% / 3.3% / 每 NT$20 累積 1 哩

rate_value.description: Numeric equivalent for sorting: percent for cashback/points, TWD-per-mile for miles

cap.description: Cap text, e.g. 每月上限 NT$500 回饋 / 無上限

conditions.description: Conditions such as registration, min spend, bundling

featured.description: Show this reward as the card's main number on list tiles (default: the reward whose number appears in headline, else the best rate)

requirements.description: Eligibility summary e.g. 年滿 18 歲，正卡年收入 NT$xx 萬以上

status.description: active = accepting applications; suspended = temporarily not accepting; discontinued = product retired

source_url.description: Official product page used as the source of truth

image_url.description: Official card face image URL (used by scripts/fetch-card-images.mjs)

image.description: Local path under public/, filled by the image fetch script

notes.description: Internal notes for maintainers, not shown on site

needs_review.description: true = data incomplete or unverified; the site hides the card until a maintainer clears it
